Agra woman arrested after husband's body found buried in home

Police in Agra have arrested Ruby Sharma after her husband's body was discovered buried beneath the bathroom floor of their residence. The man had been reported missing for 45 days. One report states the wife allegedly used sleeping pills in the husband's food before burying him.
